title: Breaches of HDB's Minimum Occupation Period (MOP) Rule and Steps to Ensure Flats are Owner-occupied during MOP
what_it_is: Breaches of HDB's Minimum Occupation Period (MOP) Rule and Steps to Ensure Flats are Owner-occupied during MOP

sections.label: Parliamentary questions on MOP breaches
sections.summary: Questions ask how HDB detects MOP breaches, how many cases came from inspections versus public reports, and whether utilities tracking or property site monitoring could be used.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) from 2017 to 2022, how many breaches of the MOP have been uncovered by HDB versus leads reported by the public; and (b) how does HDB decide on the flats to inspect monthly to detect violations on housing rules.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) of the 53 cases between 2017 and November 2022 where enforcement action has been taken by HDB for breaching MOP rules, how many cases are detected by (i) HDB's periodic inspections (ii) whistle-blowing through HDB's hotline and (iii) any other method; and (b) whether the Government will consider shifting some of the onus of reporting such breaches to real estate agents when suspicious circumstances come to their knowledge.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development whether HDB has considered (i) working with utilities companies to track utilities usage during the MOP, as an indicator of non-occupancy, in addition to the current reliance on sampling resale listings on property sites and (ii) requesting property sales sites to monitor and remove listings of properties that have been determined to have not fulfilled the physical occupancy requirements under the terms of the MOP.

sections.label: Physical occupation during MOP
sections.summary: Owners must physically occupy their flat during the Minimum Occupation Period before selling on the open market or renting out the whole flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Owners are required to physically occupy their flat during the Minimum Occupation Period (MOP), before they are allowed to sell their flat on the open market or rent out the whole flat.

sections.label: PLH model MOP length
sections.summary: The MOP for flats launched under the Prime Location Public Housing model is set at 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: For instance, the MOP for flats launched under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model is set at 10 years.

sections.label: Flats returned to HDB
sections.summary: Between January 2017 and December 2022, 258 BTO flats and 168 resale flats were returned to HDB, mostly due to changed owners' circumstances within the MOP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Between January 2017 and December 2022, a total of 258 BTO flats and 168 resale flats have been returned to HDB, mostly due to changes in owners' circumstances within the MOP, which rendered them ineligible to own an HDB flat.

sections.label: Penalties for MOP infringement
sections.summary: HDB may issue a written warning, impose a financial penalty of up to $50,000, or compulsorily acquire the flat; 53 owners faced action and 21 flats were acquired.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Depending on the severity of the infringement, HDB may issue a written warning, impose a financial penalty of up to $50,000, or compulsorily acquire the flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: From January 2017 to November 2022, HDB had taken action against 53 owners who had not occupied their flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Of these 53, 21 have had their flats compulsorily acquired due to MOP infringement.

sections.label: Warning, penalties and compulsory acquisition
sections.summary: The letter of warning, financial penalties of up to $50,000 and compulsory acquisition are serious consequences, with 21 flats compulsorily acquired.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Currently, the letter of warning and financial penalties of up to $50,000 and compulsory acquisition of the flat – these are serious consequences.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Minister, just to add on to Member Yip Hon Weng's suggestion on enforcement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: There were 21 cases, for which compulsory acquisition of the flats were meted out.

sections.label: Profit disgorgement and financial penalty
sections.summary: The Member suggested profit disgorgement, and the financial penalty is also quite high and does disgorge a lot of profit, especially in illegal subletting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As for the Member's suggestion of profit disgorgement, financial penalty is also quite high.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It does, to some extent, disgorge a lot of the profit, especially when it is illegal subletting.

sections.label: Complaints against agents breaching rules
sections.summary: Complaints against agents suspected of assisting breaches of rules including MOP rules rose from about three to about 20 per year, and HDB and CEA will work closely together.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Sometimes, more than one tool is deployed in order to zoom in.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: There are a lot of flats, a lot of homes; 1.1 million flats owned and more than 50,000 rental flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: On the first question about the number of complaints against agents who are suspected of having assisted in the breach of such rules, including MOP rules, which have increased over the last few years, from about three per year to about 20 per year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, we are concerned about this and will continue to have HDB and CEA work closely together to ensure that the understanding of the foundation of a lot of these rules relating to property and real estate are underscored by our sector.
